title: Shopify says AI-referred traffic and orders tripled year over year
friendlyTitle: More shoppers are reaching stores through AI
summary: In its Q2 2026 results, Shopify reported that traffic and orders attributed to AI services each grew to three times their year-earlier levels. The result suggests AI discovery is adding a meaningful commerce channel rather than simply replacing conventional search traffic.
friendlySummary: Shopify says visits and orders sent by AI services were three times higher than a year ago.
whyItMatters: Retailers should start measuring referrals and conversions from assistants separately, while keeping product information structured and current. The opportunity may be especially useful for smaller merchants whose products are difficult to surface through broad keyword rankings.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Online shops should make product details clear for AI tools and track which assistants send useful customers.
